description: This file defines a class `Number` for handling number formatting options within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for creating number format strings with control over decimal places, thousands separators, and locale considerations.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: A class that provides number format string generation with options for decimal precision and thousands separator, compatible with PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize number formatting with specified decimal places, separator preference, and optional locale.

methods.name: setThousandsSeparator
methods.description: Sets whether to use a thousands separator in the formatted number.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates the format string based on set properties.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Returns the format string for locale-specific formatting, simplified here due to Microsoft Excel handling limitations.
